catalog.title: San Francisco city events — official-source catalog
catalog.coverage: Publicly advertised events and recurring public programs located within the City and County of San Francisco. This is a dated, reproducible catalog; it does not claim to enumerate every private, newly announced, or unlisted event.
catalog.geography: City and County of San Francisco only
catalog.row_standard: Every published row carries an organizer, venue, or government source link. Dates, hours, locations, and admissions are shown only when stated in the linked source captured for this audit.
catalog.field_policy: An em dash means the linked source did not state that optional field in the captured record. Rows needing a decision, scope correction, or an essential missing value are separated on the Flagged for Review page.
catalog.sources_policy: Official organizer, official venue, or government sources. A small number of records use SF Travel, the City and County's official destination marketing organization, or a municipal arts calendar; those are labeled trusted civic sources.
catalog.updated_by: arena/08676041-maltaproj7 + arena/1bde1cd1-maltaproj7 re-verification, reconciled and finalized by arena/d71d78cc-maltaproj7 + arena/55c58947-maltaproj7 final integration (independent 59-row re-verification, merged)
catalog.last_reverification: 2026-10-18 — every row's source URL was re-fetched from the official publisher page (organizer, official venue, or government source) by the integration sessions; corrections, residual findings, and cross-session reconciliation are recorded in flags and research/official-source-audit.md. A third parallel re-verification (arena/55c58947-maltaproj7, log: research/reverification-55c58947.md) independently fetched all 59 rows of the pre-expansion catalog and was reconciled into this dataset on 2026-10-18.
